segments.caption: 6-move checkmate

segments.say: The Caro-Kann. White grabs the center. Black takes on e4.
segments.caption: Caro-Kann

segments.say: White sets a trap with queen e2. Black plays the natural knight f6.
segments.caption: Natural move?

segments.say: Knight d6. Checkmate. The king can't move, because its own pieces block every square.
segments.caption: Knight d6 mate

yt_title: Checkmate in 6 moves 😳 Caro-Kann smothered mate #chess
desc:
A smothered mate in just 6 moves - and it really happens in online games.

The line: 1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 dxe4 4.Nxe4 Nd7 5.Qe2 Ngf6?? 6.Nd6#

The e7 pawn is pinned by the queen, so it can't take the knight.

Ever fallen for this? 👇
